name: seneschal-mcp

tools.name: seneschal.audit
tools.description: One verdict: scan for safety, select context under budget, and route. Read-only; blocks on unsafe input.

tools.name: seneschal.broker_dry_run
tools.description: Recommend provider capacity routing without API calls or secrets.

tools.name: seneschal.budget
tools.description: Estimate token usage against a selected model profile.

tools.name: seneschal.check_capability
tools.description: Validate a requested capability and optional path.

tools.name: seneschal.health
tools.description: Run seneschal health checks.

tools.name: seneschal.make_packet
tools.description: Render a scoped context packet.

tools.name: seneschal.models
tools.description: List provider-neutral model profiles.

tools.name: seneschal.pack
tools.description: Create a compact context bundle under a token budget.

tools.name: seneschal.plan_request
tools.description: Plan a request: classify the task and recommend whether and how to call a model.

tools.name: seneschal.provider_health
tools.description: Check the reachability and readiness of configured providers.

tools.name: seneschal.provider_mark
tools.description: Record a provider's observed state (writes provider-state, no model call).

tools.name: seneschal.provider_state
tools.description: Read the recorded state of providers.

tools.name: seneschal.reuse
tools.description: Estimate stable/cacheable prompt token share.

tools.name: seneschal.route
tools.description: Recommend a model/provider path without invoking the model.

tools.name: seneschal.run
tools.description: Execute a request against the cheapest sufficient provider, gated by the request plan.

tools.name: seneschal.savings
tools.description: Estimate token and cost savings across repeated runs.

tools.name: seneschal.scan_path
tools.description: Recursively scan a file or directory using Seneschal ignore rules.

tools.name: seneschal.scan_text
tools.description: Classify untrusted text for prompt and secret-like risk.

tools.name: seneschal.select
tools.description: Select changed files and useful neighboring context under a token budget.

tools.name: seneschal.snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot context and estimate changed-only token savings.

forbidden: invoke models before scan and budget controls are explicitly enabled
